publisher_edition.title: Ensayos morales, políticos y literarios, Madrid, Trotta / Liberty Fund, 2011
publisher_edition.limitation: Publisher preview identifies translator and contents but stops before essay; institutional academic quotation gives partial I p3 and I p5b with locators pp.44–45. Full passage and reusable license not established.

institutional_evidence.detail: Thesis pp.55–56 quotes second sentence of I p3 and final clause of I p5b, citing Hume 2011 pp.44–45. Quotation contains one apparent typographic error and is not proof of original wording.

Ana Marta González, Revista de Filosofía 33.1 (2008), note 53 quotes I p5 as part of longer excerpt with ellipsis; bibliographic entry identifies María Teresa Beguiristain translation in La norma del gusto y otros ensayos, Cuadernos Teorema, Valencia 1980, pp.23–26. Original printed punctuation not independently verified.
Academic review confirms Beguiristain translation in MuVIM 2008 volume; essay included. No accessible original pages established.

research_notes.limitation: Neither translation has been verified for all four selected places; the institutional citations are partial and from different translators. Source fidelity, independent alignment and applicable quotation rights remain to be assessed.
